summary: Phase 3 Calc Engine Rollout testing complete. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — new user-accessible endpoint /api/calc-engine/execute-by-category is reachable by admin (not 403), returns 404 for bogus category, and exists for super_admin too. Frontend: Emissions page loads, list renders with CO2/CH4/N2O/Total CO2e values, Edit dialog opens WITHOUT 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error (0 infinite-loop errors detected), Add Emission dialog opens, form fields (Facility, Scope, Reporting Month, Category, Fuel, EF, Quantity, Calculated Emissions) render correctly. Sample row shows 1045.3672 tCO₂e calculated. All Phase 3 acceptance criteria met.

critical_code_review_comments: useCalcEngine.js uses executeByFormula() via super-admin-restricted /super-admin/calc-engine/execute — if this path is ever invoked from the Emissions UI for a non-superadmin user it will 403. The category path (execute-by-category) is correctly using the new user-accessible endpoint, so keep usage limited to that in the UI for now, or add a user-accessible execute-by-formula endpoint too.

Emissions.js still computes calculatedEmissions via a 500+ line useMemo (legacy) as the primary source of truth. The useCalcEngine hook is wired but not driving actual UI values yet. Phase 3 intent (force new engine, remove legacy) is not yet realized — current code is a parallel-shadow setup as the main agent noted. Plan a follow-up to flip the switch once decision trees are seeded for all categories.

Hook signature decisionInputs always sets ef_quantity_provided:'false' — this hardcodes the tree branch, which is fine as an interim default but should be derived from fuel/category config once trees are populated for multiple branches.
